confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, massive database querying, and subsequent data exfiltration via DNS tunneling and HTTPS, followed by an attempt to cover tracks by deleting logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap from IP 162.247.74.27.
Successful login of user_03 from the same malicious IP (162.247.74.27), indicating account compromise.
Unauthorized privilege escalation where user_03 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Lateral movement to the production database (prod_main).
Massive database queries targeting the 'customers' table, affecting hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP port 53) to a known malicious domain.
Large volume data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP port 443).
Attempt to cover tracks by deleting the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log).

gaps: Confirmation of whether the SQL injection (evt_s92_001-005) directly provided the credentials used in evt_s92_006.
Verification of the exact contents of the exfiltrated data.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection to compromise user_03's account, subsequently escalating privileges to DBA to access the production customer database. Following massive data retrieval, the attacker exfiltrated approximately 150MB of data via DNS and HTTPS before attempting to delete authentication logs to hide their presence.
